steps.name: Traces of Cracks (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Jade] in the "Infinite Corridor", go to the [Girl on the Roof] in the "Guild Union".

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: You are here. I didn't expect you to come so soon... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Do you remember the ‘Drifting City’ you visited before?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I still remember. The promise to make the future have a happy ending is still in progress...)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: What are you thinking... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I was thinking about something else for a moment... . Is something going on in the drifting city?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Ambrosia was looking for Adventurer. I'm not sure exactly what's going on, but I think it's about my younger brother.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anis if it's your younger brother?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Yes, you know. Then, if you have time, go to Ambrosia.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: You know where it is, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe he's sunbathing on the roof?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: That's Ambrosia's hobby too. Well then, I hope it's not a big deal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Jade.

steps.name: Traces of Cracks (2)
steps.objective: Get <K's Special Donburi> and <Durian Smoothie> and go to [Anise] in "Drifting City".

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Yay! Welcome! I've already heard the news, you're the goddess' bastard!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never thought that would become known in Freios as well.

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Don't be frustrated. Because that’s not important now!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's right. When I went to see Jade, she said she was looking for me.

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Bingo!

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: This is an official request from the Boksilboksil guild to Adventurer %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Formal request?

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: If you complete the alliance's quest, you can receive a lot of help later. Still, the Goddess' bastard must be of a pretty high rank, knowingly or unknowingly, right?

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: It's something that becomes flesh and blood.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought, but please refrain from calling that goddess a bastard... .

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: I will give you a certain job as much as you trust me. Because only %s can do this!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel like I'm being deceived, but should I adjust the rhythm appropriately?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what can I do?

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: You know my brother, right? Anis was supposed to take a vacation, but it looks like something happened in the drifting city.

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: How long did this sister wait? joy.

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Hey, not this one. I really want to go there and see his face in person, but I can't leave because I'm the guild master.

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: It's because it's hard to stay for a long time unless you're a special person. I heard it’s okay if you’re the goddess’s motherfucker %s… .

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Elias Deliver traditional food to the drifting city.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Food delivery?

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Anis and Müller say they want to eat exotic food these days. So, I want %s to get it and bring it to me!

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Hehe, will you do it?

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: (Ambrosia stares at you with twinkling eyes. Her eyes are shining brightly as if they were filled with starlight in the night sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay… .

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Hehe… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, okay. I'll do it. Instead, you will receive a proper reward!! Don't even say that the goddess is a bastard!

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Yay! good. also! I'll give you the best food container, so you must find food and deliver it to the drifting city. Okay? Delivery bastard!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Why is this another mess... . Okay, okay. Just deliver and I'll be back. There's a lot to do.

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Thank you! I'll tell Narsha and the president well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (President? Narsha?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s think about it after we’ve been there. It’s been a while since we went to a drifting city….)

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Hello. %s! Long time no see! But this smell... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: At Ambrosia's request, I brought Elias traditional food!

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Thank you, I was already hungry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief. bon appetit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The lonely image of the drifting city comes into view. Things that happened here in the past begin to come to mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I didn’t lose my memories of this place.)

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Sister, is Ambrosia okay? I guess I sent it like this because I was well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something is being done on the roof, but I don't know what. After this request is over, President Narsharang? They say they will talk to them well.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Oh, with the president… . Ah, Narsha… . Ahahaha. I feel sorry for Narsha. I should have come with you a long time ago. I guess you're not upset yet.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: I'm out of my mind right now. Huh… . I'm a bit busy these days.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Müller looks too busy to even eat.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: I also have some time to eat... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: As you know from your previous help, the drifting city is full of things to research. We need to study the situation here and think about what to do for the future.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Some time ago, something strange started appearing here and there in the city. What should I say? It was a black hole.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: It felt like a door to another world. Neither Mr. Müller nor I could do anything about it, so we were looking for a way.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: But then Adventurer happened to come!

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: (Anis stares at you, her eyes sparkling. Her eyes also look as brilliant as the starlight shining in the center of the dawn sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what can I do?

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: I haven't said anything else yet, but you're doing me a favor!! I just want to thank you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then tell me the story.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Well, I would like to hear the opinion of someone who is familiar with this matter. I was wondering if %s might know someone who is familiar with this situation.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: I'm a bit anxious to just wait for help from the empire... . And there are some people in Congress who are uncomfortable... .

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: So! I hope %s can help. Of course, you brought it up first, but I will also talk to the president and Narsha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is someone that comes to mind... . Let's talk once we get there.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…Does Saraswati know?)

steps.name: Traces of Cracks (4)
steps.objective: Obtain <Flame of Maw> from "Maw Room" and <Windy Seed's Barrier Fragment> from "Magic Academy Main Building" and deliver them to [Saraswati] in "Compartment 3".

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: It's been a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How are you?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Nothing much happened. Seeing that %s is here, I have some idea of ​​what's going on.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, as expected… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Explain that strange phenomena occur in the drifting city.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: The place where Adventurer experienced another realm of time. You don't feel like there's another dimension to the city.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: The data from the hyperspace network has been re-established to check, but it is still the same.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: A strange phenomenon occurred in the drifting city... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: This is probably because the Great Wall, the wall that prevents interference between other dimensions, is shaking. It feels like someone is shaking it... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: %s The fact that the person you were looking for has the power of a god also has some influence.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you saying this is also part of the abnormal phenomenon that occurred when Iris ran away?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Based on the data, this is not accurate. Except it affected me… .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: %s, if you find an item from another world and bring it to me, I will analyze it and give you an answer. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Among the places that Adventurer visited recently, are there any places where you felt strong traces of the demon world?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hell's Room and Magic Academy Zerenis... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Output data. Flame of the abyss, Windy Seed's barrier fragment... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Please bring me this item.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Since this is from another dimension, please be careful.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: You've been there. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. Here's the thing... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: We will proceed with the analysis right away. however… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong? Is there any problem?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: An error occurred. Again, since the composition of this object is different from that of the planet, a different method is needed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, then what should I do? Shall I bring something else?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: No. it's okay. You don't have to worry too much.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: (The blue holographic keyboard in front of Saraswati disappears, and a red holographic keyboard appears.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Opens new protocols not used in existing network modes. Mantra… .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: (Saraswati looks intently at the screen floating in the air and moves her hands vigorously.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Analysis is complete. The item you brought was lost during the analysis process.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could you explain now?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Yes. Let me explain. All the items you brought were affected by the energy of the demon world.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: The Flame of Hell appears to have appeared after the Demon World and the Chamber of Hell were blocked. Additionally, it was an external force that destroyed the Wind Seed barrier and tore it into pieces.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: It seems like someone took advantage of the gap in space and time to use some of the power of the demon world. Does anyone have any guess?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have someone in mind, but I'm not sure...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… . I'm not sure. Sarasvati is everything in the hypertime network, can't you tell?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Hmm… . How should I explain it... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Adventurer knows the different timelines of this planet's fate. It all started in the city where I met a different girl.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I can't tell you, but there are times and spaces that Asgard's scientific power cannot explain. Especially places like the Demon World... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Aside from that, the appearance of Adventurer was a variable for everyone. From the hyperspace network to anyone else targeting this place... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Whenever Adventurer solved a task in a certain location, the hyperspace network would cause a minor error.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Still, the data was updated by opening a new protocol, and errors were minimized. This only applied to Adventurer... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's very difficult.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: What I can say for sure is that Adventurer is shaping the future of this planet for the better.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Yoohoo, Saraswati, give this older sister that same compliment! I want to be praised. Saraswati! Sarah… !!

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: (As Saraswati frowns, the video of Freya stops appearing.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: The noisy sister is an emissary. I don't want to be disturbed, so I've blocked it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It's been a long time since I've appeared, but I can't believe I got blocked like that... . Somehow I feel sorry... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Even if she is blocked, she somehow manages to get through. Anyway, what was happening in the city was brought under control.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, how? So fast?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: During the analysis process, some of the items brought were disassembled and sent through a gap in space and time. The phenomena that appear in the city are unlikely to appear for some time.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: This is a temporary solution. No matter how hyperspace-time network it is, it cannot be involved in every timeline in this world. It's just that Adventurer... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I know what you're going to say. Thank you, Saraswati.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Now let the person in that city know that it has been resolved. Thanks to this, we were able to collect a lot of data.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Saraswati. Then I'll go talk to the people there.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I'm going to be busy for a while. Adventurer and I too... .

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Saraswati, praise this sister! I want to be praised. Saraswati! Sarah… !!

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Adventurer!! Adventurer!!

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: The hole that appeared in the city is gone! How did you do it?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, thank goodness. As expected, their scientific power is amazing.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Is that a place called Asgard?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: As expected, there seems to be something different about those people. They already came down to the Imperial Workshop and taught us various technologies and science-related information.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: I think it's on a different level from the Freios people's way of thinking.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Anyway, thank you. Thanks to this, I was able to focus solely on research. And I'm going to my sister's to spend my vacation! Ta-da☆

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Me too, I want to rest too….)

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: And I'm going to meet Narsha and do various things. It's all thanks to Adventurer~

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (After all, twins seem to be twins. Even their actions are the same.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Since this is a guild union matter, I will properly report it to President Dana. See you next time.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: I'm late to say hello. %s… . On behalf of the Empire, I express my gratitude.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Then, Anis and Mr. Müller, see you again next time.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: … Oh, you're already gone. I had something to say... .

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Miss Anise.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Ah, Mr. Müller. What does the Imperial Council say?

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Nothing much was said. It seemed like he still wanted to stop his activities here.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Hehe, then we can just do what we always do.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Well, but… . By the way, speaking of President Dana, is he eligible now?

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: You can enter the guild union city… .

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Perhaps the president knows? All I can do is tell you a story.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Ah, Mr. Müller! What are you going to do during your vacation? Don’t you have to go see Lena?!

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: It looks like Lena will be busy for a while. Because they are important talents needed in many places.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Of course! Because Lena is an amazing person. Then I'll clean up and go see my sister! Please take care of me while I am gone, Mr. Müller!

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Yes. Have a nice trip.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Phew… . The daughter of the Hiren family will take care of it, right?

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: It's obvious what will happen to Adventurer, who has a connection with the three sisters... .
